terms.definition: Identical antibodies made from a single clone of cells, specific to one binding site on one protein antigen.
terms.examiner: Separate Biology only, higher tier for how they are produced.

terms.definition: A cell made by fusing a mouse lymphocyte with a tumour cell: it makes one type of antibody and divides rapidly.
terms.examiner: The lymphocyte makes the antibody; the tumour cell divides.

terms.definition: A protein on the surface of a cell or pathogen that a specific antibody binds to.
terms.examiner: The antibody binds only to its complementary antigen.

terms.definition: Pregnancy tests, measuring hormones and chemicals in blood, research to locate molecules in cells, and treating some cancers by carrying a drug to cancer cells.
terms.examiner: They cause more side effects than first expected.
